why:
RE-VERDICTED phase-417 W4.a. was `gap`, and the complaint it was filed under is closed: the `nros` facade exports the type now, so a user can match on WHY a wire value was rejected rather than reading the sentence `reason()` put in the `SetParametersResult`. What remains is the NAME — rclrs's `RmwParameterConversionError` against our `ValueConversionError`, which is where the conversion actually happens (`nros-node`'s `parameter_services`, between an `rcl_interfaces` value and the store's). `rename` because no platform constraint picks either spelling; the export is what a porting user needed.

issue 1637 (2026-10-05) — ENVELOPE WRITTEN where a porting user reads it: the rename was stated only in plain `//` facade comments; `ValueConversionError`'s own rustdoc now names rclrs's spelling.
